lines: To get started, configure a workflow in Xcode and start building your app in Xcode Cloud in just a few minutes.1 The build status is displayed in Xcode and reports show the results immediately after the build finishes.

A compute hour is an hour of time used to execute a specific task in the cloud, such as building an app or running automated tests.
